items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: they had Peter, Cantrell playing drum, Laurie Warnick playing saxophone, Henry playing bass tuba, Charlie was playing Berenville.

ctx.x: Who were some of the other musicians in your family other than your daddy?
Well, they had, uh, Peter, Charlie, Henry, and my little brother Wilkins. Mm-hmm.
And, uh, what instruments did they play, like your daddy? What instruments did he play?
